title: How to export Notely 3 notes to Markdown
metaDescription: Export every Notely 3 note to plain Markdown files with images intact, in about two minutes on a Mac, then spot-check that nothing broke on the way.
excerpt: I exported a 4,200-note vault from Notely 3 to plain Markdown in 73 seconds. Here are the steps, and how to check the result before you trust it.
_note: EXAMPLE FILE. Notely 3 is invented. The figures (4,200 notes, 73 seconds, 50 spot-checked, version 3.2.1 on macOS 15.2) come from the example review; the menu names in the steps are illustrative only. Copy the shape for your own how-tos, then delete this file.
answer: Open the export screen, choose Markdown, and export the whole vault in one go. On a 4,200-note vault this took 73 seconds, and the 50 notes I spot-checked kept their images and links. You end up with a folder of ordinary Markdown files that any editor can open.

testing.duration: One full export, then a spot check of 50 notes
testing.setup: MacBook Air M2 (16GB, macOS 15.2), Notely 3.2.1 desktop, a 4,200-note vault of about 180MB on the paid Plus plan.

timeNeeded: About five minutes, plus the export itself
requirements: Notely 3.2 or later on a desktop computer
Free disk space at least equal to your vault size
A recent backup of your vault, in case you change anything afterwards

steps.title: Open the export screen
steps.body: In the desktop app, open **Settings** and choose **Export**.

steps.title: Choose Markdown
steps.body: Set the format to **Markdown**. HTML and PDF are also offered, but Markdown gives you plain files that are not locked to Notely.

steps.title: Export the whole vault
steps.body: Choose an empty folder as the destination and select **Export all**. Leave the app open until the progress bar finishes. On my vault this took 73 seconds.

steps.title: Check a sample of notes
steps.body: Open a handful of exported notes in a plain text editor, including some with images and links between notes. I checked 50 and none were broken.

sections.heading: How to undo it
sections.body: Exporting does not change your notes in Notely, so there is nothing to undo. Delete the export folder if you no longer need it.

faq.q: Does exporting remove my notes from Notely?
faq.a: No. The export is a copy. Your vault in Notely stays exactly as it was.
